description: After /workflow, a project write is allowed only when an approved offer covers it (hooks/approval.py): the agent presents the offer from `record.py offer present` and asks one question (Show review.html first, Approve from this summary, Change something; a lightweight offer asks Approve or Change something), either as the question tool or as text where the owner types the answer; the owner's answer in the conversation approves it, checked again in later sessions, and a later withdrawal, narrowing or stop counts. Git writes and MCP write tools need the operation named in the offer. Styling writes also need the machine CSS switch (~/.workflow-axa/settings.json, off by default), and changing the switch needs the owner's Yes to that exact question. Offer records, the switch and the frozen list of pre-offer approvals can't be written directly. Tasks approved before the offer model (listed by the owner with legacy_inventory.py at the upgrade) keep their Approval-line check through phase_gate.py. It also blocks git clean, deleting .artifacts itself and wildcard deletes under it, and package installs and npx-style downloads unless the user's latest words allow installing; an open rules question pauses writes. At session start it names second copies of workflow-axa skills and explains how to settle them; it never blocks for them. Delivery checks the review evidence itself (completion_check.py); there is no Stop hook.
